en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of an outdoor café or beer garden set in a dense deciduous forest. Numerous folding metal chairs and tables with white tablecloths fill a clearing beneath tall trees. A few people, including women and children in mid‑20th‑century clothing, sit or stand among the tables. In the background are simple wooden pavilions or kiosks, and on the right a small covered bandstand or gazebo with a domed roof. Hanging lanterns or lights are visible among the trees.
